FISHING LICENCE · HONDURAS

Honduras fishing licence

DIGEPESCA lists a sport fisher permit and a separate permit category for tourism businesses. Confirm the visitor permit before your trip; a tourism operator's permit does not establish a guest exemption.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Sport fishers fall within DIGEPESCA's published permit categories.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Sport fisher permit, published 2023 feeanyHNL 500

Rules visitors should know

  • Submit the applicable identity and photograph documents.
  • Pay the government fee through the prescribed TGR process.
  • Release billfish caught during sport or tourism fishing.

How to buy

Apply at a DIGEPESCA regional office or the central Control and Inspection Department.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Honduras?

DIGEPESCA lists a sport fisher permit and a separate permit category for tourism businesses. Confirm the visitor permit before your trip; a tourism operator's permit does not establish a guest exemption.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Honduras?

Sport fisher permit, published 2023 fee: HNL 500 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Honduras?

Apply at a DIGEPESCA regional office or the central Control and Inspection Department.
